def calculate_minimum_initial_passengers() -> int:
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    A = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    cumulative_sum = 0
    min_cumulative_sum = 0
    
    for i in A:
        cumulative_sum += i
        min_cumulative_sum = min(min_cumulative_sum, cumulative_sum)
    
    min_initial_passengers = -min_cumulative_sum if min_cumulative_sum < 0 else 0
    print(min_initial_passengers)
